races.display_title: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A typically interesting novice for the track with AQUA BLEU selected to come out on top. Warren Greatrex's 4-y-o boasts plenty of experience having scored 3 times in junior hurdles last season and with his Aintree reappearance second under his belt, he's interesting now tackling a longer trip. Well Achieved landed his only start in points and is respected, with recent course runner up Sappingirl and returning Trial by Jury others commanding plenty of respect. AQUA BLEU (IRE) WELL ACHIEVED (IRE) SAPPINGIRL (IRE)

races.display_title: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FAIRY PARK seems a bit of an edgy sort but she looked a good prospect on the evidence of her 2 bumper efforts last season, which she duly confirmed when hammering a next-time-out winner on her Ffos Las hurdling debut, and strikes as the type to go on to much better things. Expensive point recruit Royal Response impressed over C&D earlier in the month and is open to plenty of improvement, too, while the scopey Ti'mamzel shouldn't be taken lightly as a dual listed bumper winner. FAIRY PARK (IRE) ROYAL RESPONSE (IRE) TI'MAMZEL (FR)

races.display_title: Coral Sir Peter O'Sullevan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This looks ultra competitive with the progressive NORN IRON topping the shortlist having prevented a Willie Mullins 1-2-3 when second at the Punchestown Festival. races.display_title: Coral Racing Club Intermediate Handicap Hurdle (Reg' As The Gerry Feilden) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A good-looking renewal of the Gerry Feilden. IDAHO SUN was seen to better effect than subsequent Supreme third Mydaddypaddy when accounting for him in the Grade 1 Formby at Aintree when last seen, but that form still makes him look well treated from an opening mark in the early 140s, so there's every reason to believe he can maintain his unbeaten record over hurdles. Mondo Man is well worth another chance given the strength of his Imperial Cup win, with The Mighty Celt completing the shortlist. IDAHO SUN (IRE) MONDO MAN THE MIGHTY CELT (IRE)

races.verdict: WENDIGO got away without his handicap mark going up for his Carlisle reappearance success, a move which could prove lenient based on what was a clear career best on Timeform ratings. Regent's Stroll , whose novice form ties in with recent Paddy Power victor Meetmebythesea, Road To Home and Miami Magic are feared most in that order. WENDIGO (FR) REGENT'S STROLL (IRE) ROAD TO HOME (IRE)

races.display_title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WRECKLESS ERIC made a promising start in this sphere when runner-up at Ffos Las and can build on it to go one better off a handy-looking mark here. Last year's victor Ryan's Rocket is also of interest off his current mark and rates a big threat though, while both Un Sens A La Vie and Largy Belter command plenty of respect with better days still ahead. Pure Carbon and The Four Sixes complete the shortlist in this cracking handicap. WRECKLESS ERIC RYAN'S ROCKET (IRE) UN SENS A LA VIE (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Un Sens A La Vie (13/8), Ryan's Rocket (9/2), Wreckless Eric (11/2), Largy Belter (6/1), Pleasington (15/2), Pure Carbon (8/1), Daytime Dreaming (8/1), The Four Sixes (17/2), Jour D'Evasion (18/1), Escapeandevade (18/1), Breaking Cover (22/1), Stencil (28/1), Jony R (66/1)

races.display_title: J&D Pierce Steeling The Race Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: RED DELTA shaped well when fourth behind Passengerontheship at Sedgefield (boosted form since) on his return and showed his liking for this track when an excellent third in last season's Eider Chase so gets the vote on these revised terms. The latter named rates a big threat though in his hat-trick bid, while Impatient and I Wish You can also play a prominent role in this intriguing handicap. RED DELTA PASSENGERONTHESHIP (IRE) IMPATIENT (FR)

races.display_title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: There was definite promise to glean from UNFURLED 's debut second at Wolverhampton 32 days ago and, appealing as a likely improver with that run under her belt, she could be the answer with her yard firmly amongst the winners of late. Mantuba and Secha are 2 very appealing newcomers from leading stables and may offer up chief resistance before market clues. UNFURLED (IRE) MANTUBA (IRE) SECHA

races.display_title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict: PALMS OASIS continued his theme of race-by-race progress when opening his account at the third attempt in a C&D novice 3 weeks ago, defeating a next-time-out winner in the process. An opening mark of 74 looks fair on that evidence and he's selected to follow up. Blue Pete is another going the right way and feared, with similar comments applying to Henley on Thames . Lady Blanche also worthy of note in a good race of its type. PALMS OASIS BLUE PETE (IRE) HENLEY ON THAMES (IRE)

races.display_title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict: Dual C&D winner ELYAM maintained his 100% record for Michael Herrington and found further progress to boot when bringing up the hat-trick in determined style at Newcastle 4 weeks ago. A low-mileage 4-y-o, he firmly appeals as the type to rate higher still and is selected to defy the handicapper again. Ancient State has been a fine advert for the Adam Kirby yard this year and is feared, whilst a pace duel could well bring admirable veteran Baldomero into contention late in the piece. ELYAM ANCIENT STATE (IRE) BALDOMERO (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Elyam (11/10), Rhythm N Hooves (5/2), Ancient State (5/1), Baldomero (12/1), Dazzling Haze (14/1), Jack The Bachelor (16/1)

races.verdict: WINGMEN showed good resolution to rally and lead close home at Navan a fortnight ago and is fancied to follow up back in handicap company. Western Diego is feared most returned to this venue having been placed in this race last year before landing a valuable C&D handicap, while Raffles Dolce Vita and Moudan are also respected. WINGMEN (IRE) WESTERN DIEGO (IRE) RAFFLES DOLCE VITA (FR)

races.verdict: HEY NOW shaped well on his return when fourth at Wexford and with this longer trip a likely big plus, he edges the vote in this highly competitive handicap.
